# surflist

> surflist is a directory for surf trips, organised by destination. Each surf town has a hub page ("Surfing in <town>") linking to its surf schools, surf shops, places to stay (camps, hostels, eco-pods, campervans) and surf services like board repair. Browse from country to region to town, or by category.

## Browse by type

- [Surf schools](https://surflist.co/surf-schools/): Learn to surf or level up with schools and coaches near the break.
- [Surf shops](https://surflist.co/surf-shops/): Independent surf shops for boards, wetsuits, rentals and repairs.
- [Places to stay](https://surflist.co/surf-stays/): Surf camps, hostels, eco-pods and campervans close to the waves.
- [Surf services](https://surflist.co/surf-services/): Board repair, ding fixes and other surf services.

## About

Basic listings are free and link out to each business; verified listings get a dedicated page with address, coordinates and pricing. To get listed, see https://surflist.co/list-your-business/ or email hello@surflist.co. Read more about surflist at https://surflist.co/about/.
